description: Verso: List of names in Judaeo-Arabic: Abū ʿAlī and his brother; Manṣūr Nufayʿ; Manṣūr Nuʿmān; Majd Dayyan; Ḥusayn and Yaʿqūb of Marrakesh (Marrākushī), Yosef b. Shelomo; Yosef b. ʿIwaḍ; Ṣedaqa b. Bū Naṣr; Manṣūr Ibn al-Naqqād; Sulamān Ibn al-Parnas and his brother's son; Manṣūr and Bū ʿlī the sons of Saʿdān; Fuḍayl b. Bū ʿUmar; Eliyya and his brother; Abū Saʿd Kohen; Bū Riḍā Kohen; Bū Isḥāq Kohen. There is a cryptic concluding note that may explain the purpose of the list, then "amen neṣaḥ sela"
